noKittyNote: THERE IS NO KITTY. All 24 cards are dealt out, six each, so the only hidden cards are the other players' hands.
gameTargetNote: The first team to {{n}} points wins.
bidNotice: Choose how many tricks to bid. THE FLOOR IS THREE.
dealerEqualNote: THE DEALER ALONE MAY EQUAL the standing bid. Every other seat has to beat it.
noTrumpLowNote: AT NO TRUMP LOW THE RANKING REVERSES and the nine is highest (9 > 10 > J > Q > K > A).
playNotice: Following suit is compulsory. THE LEFT BOWER (the same-colour jack) COUNTS AS A TRUMP.
setCostNote: A SET COSTS THE BID, not the tricks taken. THE DEFENDERS STILL SCORE THEIR TRICKS.

tutorial.info: The hand number, the contract and the trump appear here.
tutorial.players: Each seat's team and trick count. There is no kitty, and the other hands stay concealed to the end.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Following suit is compulsory, so cards you cannot play are disabled. The left bower counts as a trump.
tutorial.actions: Choose how many tricks to bid (three is the floor). Note that the dealer alone may equal the standing bid.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.

frontendHint.bideuchreForced: The only legal card — following is compulsory and the left bower is a trump
frontendHint.bideuchreLowRanking: No-trump low: the ranking reverses and the nine is the highest card
frontendHint.bideuchreChoose: Several cards are legal — pick from the highlighted ones
